'''Rod Dobson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Milford tournament]] on 1 December 2001 with DS Combat and LS Combat, according to Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3138">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-madskills-at-milford-ma-12-1-01d3138/ madskills-at-milford-ma-12-1-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 2 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-02-madskills-at-milford-ma-12-1-01d3138/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
